human_instruction: Implement a read-only adopt-project command. It must inspect the current working directory using Path.cwd(), detect existing Kajiya-compatible artifacts, classify the repository, report whether init-project should not be used, report missing recommended artifacts, and return a JSON-compatible adoption plan. It must not create, modify, or delete files.
forbidden_actions: Do not create, modify, or delete project files from adopt-project.
Do not run init-project from adopt-project.
Do not modify docs/state/backlog.json or docs/state/current-project.json.
